candidates.counter_evidence_explanation: Healthy order/gateway metrics and OK order trace show the fault is not upstream; they are consistent with a payment-local latency fault.
missing_evidence: Payment dependency-level traces identifying which downstream call exceeds its deadline
Payment db_pool_waiters and dependency_timeouts breakdown to exclude pool exhaustion
candidates.statement: Payment service shows elevated latency (p95 1600ms) and a 1350ms ERROR payment.authorize span with 7 downstream_deadline_exceeded 504 warnings, while gateway, order, and inventory remain healthy (p95 79ms, error_rate 0.001). This localizes the checkout degradation to payment downstream latency.
candidates.uncertainty: Root downstream of payment is unidentified; could be payment-internal or an unlisted dependency.

report.explanation: Payment is the only service with elevated latency and errors (p95 1600ms, ERROR authorize span, 504 deadline warnings), while gateway, order, and inventory are healthy. Order deploy record alone does not establish causation. Bounded candidate is downstream latency at payment; the specific downstream dependency remains unconfirmed.
